notes.title: tiny update
notes.content: still no achievements, but I've added a proper loading image because being shown a black screen for potentially 30 seconds while the live2d loads is worrying.

notes.title: Update notes for 29/06/2024
notes.content:
In this update I've fixed a lot of issues with the end of game gallery.
sofia is no longer transparent in the bad end.
scenes properly fade in at the other end.


unfortunately, nothing I've tried has fixed the acheivements. I suspect that updating my nwjs version recently has stopped the plugin working. since theres nothing different about this project from phantom thief sylphy, which had them work just fine.
